name: self.mp3
description: A private music library you actually own. Import, tag, sync to your phone, listen offline.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run web --workspace @selfmp3/app -- --port 4601
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run export:web --workspace @selfmp3/app && npm run dist --workspace @selfmp3/desktop
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/extension
scripts.typecheck:verify: tsc -p verify --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/verify --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/verify --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @selfmp3/app
scripts.check:app: npm run typecheck:app && npm run lint:app && npm run test:app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:verify && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:exports && npm run test && npm run check:app
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf tsconfig.tsbuildinfo apps/mobile apps/web packages/cloud
